name: team-classic
blurb: Animated team member grid with pink background and scroll animations.
description: A team showcase layout with pink background, animated heading and description. Team member cards with photos, names, roles, and social media links.
use_when: About pages or team showcases where animated heading and member profiles create a welcoming, personal brand presence.
avoid_when: High-contrast or minimal-motion contexts where animations could distract or fail accessibility standards.
a11y: Heading hierarchy is semantic; team info is text-readable. Social icons pair with text links. Animations respect component motion settings.
